project_name: Samvad Editorial News Moderation Command Center

hierarchy.hindi_content_text: font-serif text-base leading-relaxed text-emerald-400 dark:text-emerald-300 font-medium

approve_for_rewrite_button.label: Approve for Rewrite
approve_for_rewrite_button.required_visibility: MUST be prominently rendered right next to every news item with status 'Pending_Review'. Never hide under submenus or overflow dropdowns.
approve_for_rewrite_button.action_behavior: Triggers POST request to AI rewrite API endpoint -> updates item state locally to loading state ('Rewriting in Journalistic Hindi...') -> updates status to 'Rewritten_Pending_Publish' upon completion with Hindi translation preview -> triggers Sonner toast notification.

core_feature_specifications.content_inspection_view: Side-by-side or split pane view comparing Original Source Draft (English/Regional) vs AI Journalistic Hindi Rewrite with grammar, entity highlights, and editorial confidence badge.

image_urls.description: Field journalist covering live breaking event
Journalist with microphone in the field

layout_strategy.card_style: rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 p-5 space-y-4

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, filter chips, dialog triggers, status badges) MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure FastAPI backend has routes for GET /api/news, POST /api/news, POST /api/news/{id}/approve-rewrite, and POST /api/news/{id}/publish.
Backend AI rewrite function should translate/rewrite content into authentic high-quality journalistic Hindi ('Patrakariya Hindi').
Include pre-seeded realistic sample news items with statuses 'Pending_Review', 'Rewritten_Pending_Publish', and 'Published' so the queue is rich upon first view.
For every news item with status 'Pending_Review', render a visible, clickable button labeled 'Approve for Rewrite' with a sparkle/spark icon right inside or alongside the item card/row.
When clicked, set local loading state, call backend rewrite endpoint, display the generated Hindi output, and update status badge dynamically to 'Rewritten_Pending_Publish'.
Provide a split-view or modal inspection drawer to compare Original text vs Rewritten Hindi text.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when items are rewritten or published.
Strictly follow all data-testid conventions specified.
